Design education your team will actually finish.

We run the same cohort model inside companies: twelve to sixteen people, one live room, one artefact, six weeks.

Book a callDownload the L&D prospectus
NorthlineKestrel StudioFoundry LabsMarlowe & CoBraid CollectiveAtlas Type

The problem

Seat licences get bought, opened twice and forgotten. Completion is the only number that matters, and most platforms will not show it to you.

A private cohort changes the incentives. Attendance is visible, the artefact is shared, and the manager who sponsored it can see the work rather than the login count.

How we work with teams

  1. Scope — one call, one page of outcomes you actually need.
  2. Select — we name the faculty lead and send a written syllabus for approval.
  3. Run — six weeks, one room, weekly notes to the sponsor.
  4. Report — an artefact, a rubric score per person, and a short written review.

What happens next

If a private cohort is not the right shape, we will say so and suggest a public one instead.
